warnings.details: This review does not attest current live GPU0 identity, current Windows ownership, GPU1 availability, CUDA witness success or actual retirement/parallel launch. Those must be evidenced by execution receipts. Existing documented-launch R2 is historical source-bound input, not a new observation by this reviewer.

After observer retirement the root operator owns both observations and collection. Cost0.15, all3 scores, result audit, original parent-training exit warning and test gate remain mandatory. The script deliberately creates no replacement background watcher.

Cost0 spans solo and parallel load. Recent256-frame service FPS and15-minute combined throughput cannot establish paired speedup. Trace counting sees flushed rows and can lag real progress; keep timestamps and this load disclosure with final capacity/FPS reporting.

The native exit receipt is read after a2-second settle. Missing/late receipt or later SSH/identity/launch failure aborts the script after retirement; original detached NN continues. Inspect original native receipt, before/retirement records and actual task state before any manual continuation; do not relaunch the old serial observer or retry the ops script blindly.

Use the documented existing PowerShell7 environment. Historical R1 documented launch failed from a different PowerShell module environment, while R2 used direct invocation successfully. No project compatibility layer was added.

failure_and_task_preservation.details: Preflight failure throws before observer retirement. After retirement, a failed identity check/launch stops the ops script without retry; original GPU0 process is detached by the original helper and is not sent a signal. Success re-entry is prevented by the execution-state guard; a post-retirement failure also cannot blindly replay the old-owner check because that owner is absent. Root must inspect receipts and assume monitoring after retirement.
